entity: Tesla's Fremont factory: Bay Area Air District violation notices and enforcement since 2019
what_we_add: Second of 86 Bay Area plants by notices; notices written on 133 days; peers' median 28 formal actions per 100 notices vs none for Tesla; Phillips 66 Rodeo (213 notices) also got none
why: SFGATE and Drive Tesla Canada name Tesla: 369 notices in five years (ours 356, 4% off), all still pending, no financial penalties. Tension, not scored as a contradiction: KQED reports a $1M district settlement in May 2021 and the district sought an abatement order in 2024, which undercuts 'no enforcement since 2019', but no quote ties the settlement to post-2019 notices or shows the order was issued.
